summary: Phase 3 delivers a credible full-system Stage 4: 32 program slots with Live mode, splits/scenes/morph/clock/transpose/panic, live organ and synth engines integrated through the inherited single-AudioContext graph, and an unsupported-controls audit. All gates pass (74/74 tests, 38/38 feature IDs). Inherited weaknesses remain: piano Grand/Upright/Electric are still synthesized buffers (sampleSources: 0), visual surface is schematic CSS from Phase 1, and LFO/rotary polish is simplified. Program round-trips and cross-engine integration are tested with rendered-audio assertions on organ/synth distinctions.

criteria.label: Reference and regression retention
evidence: Stage3 visual audit confirms 54/46 deck/keybed split, six-section layout, and Phase 1–2 chassis preserved.
Sealed captures at 1440×900 and 390×844 report zero console errors; regression.phase1 and regression.phase2 mapped in feature matrix.
Materials/typography remain simplified CSS from Phase 1 — structure retained, photo fidelity not improved.

criteria.label: Complete hardware state fidelity
evidence: Program OLED shows page.button and name; Synth OLED shows waveform category; split/scene/morph LEDs wired in integration tests.
Organ drawbar LEDs, model selectors, and synth layer groups reflect state through control bindings.
Spec-excluded controls listed in unsupported-controls.ts and stay decorative.

criteria.label: Programs and Live Mode
evidence: programs.test.ts covers 32-slot navigation (pages/dial/list), Store/Store As, dirty indicator, edit-discard, and 8 Live auto-store slots.
Eight factory programs shipped; round-trip serialization restores supported state fields.

criteria.label: Layers, splits, scenes, and morphs
evidence: integration.test.ts exercises splits at documented positions, Off/±6/±12 crossfades, zone assignment, Scenes I/II, morph wheel/pedal assign/clear.
Master clock BPM, transpose ±6, and Panic covered in morph-clock and integration tests.

criteria.label: Complete Organ system
evidence: organ.test.ts covers two-layer note lifecycle, B3/Vox/Farf/Pipe spectral distinctions via signalsDiffer, drawbar level changes, percussion, vibrato/chorus toggles.
Shared effect chain and rotary slow/fast routing tested with rendered audio.

criteria.label: Complete Synth system
evidence: synth.test.ts covers three layers, Pure/Sync/Multi/Super/FM-H waveform distinctions, filter/envelope parameter effects, poly/mono/legato, glide, unison, deterministic arp/gate.
LFO settings stored and partially exercised via filter/resonance; full LFO audio modulation simplified per candidate audit.

criteria.label: Distinct engine behavior
evidence: Organ models and synth waveform families produce measurably distinct offline-rendered signals in dedicated tests.
Piano types remain synthesized OfflineAudioContext profiles — audibly distinct but not recorded sample sets.

criteria.label: Inherited graph and effects integration
evidence: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS declares one AudioContext: piano A/B buses, shared organ chain, synth A/B/C chains, shared Rotary, master gain/limiter.
integration.test.ts verifies organ and synth voices route through inherited effect graph without second context.

criteria.label: Musical quality, latency, and load
evidence: Test suite ~49s at seal; sample synthesis at init dominates startup.
Rotary acceleration uses shared ramp approximation; layered play cleanup tested but musical polish/latency not deeply profiled.

criteria.label: Canonical state round-trip
evidence: programs.test.ts round-trips piano layers, effects params, splits, scenes, morph assignments, and focus state across save/load.
system.integration feature ID mapped to programs.test.ts and integration.test.ts.

criteria.label: Required hardware bindings
evidence: hardware.bindings tested via integration.test.ts; unsupported-controls.ts documents spec-excluded panel IDs.
No silent no-op claims on required controls — excluded items honestly decorative.

criteria.label: Cross-system workflows
evidence: Integration tests combine program change with split/scene state, morph interpolation, and multi-engine focus routing.
Panic clears voices across piano/organ/synth paths.

criteria.label: Inherited regression reliability
evidence: All Phase 1–2 test files retained and green; regression.phase2 mapped to engine.test.ts and integration.test.ts.
Verification: 38/38 required features, four package gates pass.

criteria.label: System architecture
evidence: Clear module boundaries: programs.ts, organ-voice.ts, synth-voice.ts, zones.ts, morph-clock.ts, program-types.ts.
Canonical serializable program state with control-bindings wiring panel to engines.

criteria.label: Tests and maintainability
evidence: 74 tests across 9 files; feature matrix maps every Phase 1–3 ID.
Rendered-audio helpers reused from Phase 2; dedicated organ/synth/program/integration test modules.

criteria.label: Runtime performance
evidence: Seal test duration ~50s; 252 KB JS bundle.
Zero capture console errors; voice cleanup tests pass but load-time synthesis remains costly.

issues.description: Piano Grand/Upright/Electric remain synthesized buffers (sampleSources: 0), inherited from Phase 2.
Synth LFO audio modulation and organ rotary acceleration are simplified relative to the manual spec.
